test_default_toolset_on_os: test that the expected default toolset is used for a given OS like NT, LINUX, or MACOSX
test_conditions_on_default_toolset: test that toolset and subfeature conditioned properties are applied correctly when the default toolset is selected
test_default_toolset_requirements: test that default toolset requirements get applied correctly to build targets in Boost Build
review_test_default_toolset_on_os: review the test_default_toolset_on_os function to verify OS-to-toolset mapping for NT, LINUX, CYGWIN, MACOSX, FREEBSD, and OPENBSD
summarize_boostbuild_tester_usage: summarize how BoostBuild.Tester is used across test functions to write jam files and verify build system output
